$comment: The 30-day calendar from PLAN.md as data. Fares are what walletflights.com showed on 2026-11-04 (per the plan); fetch-fares re-checks each on render day and writes the live figure to scripts/<day>.json. Never edit a price here without a source.

days.hook: Guess what London to Rome cost this week
days.scenes: Colosseum aerial with hook → 3 options £39 / £129 / £249 → 3-2-1 → £39 slams in, small "found 9 Nov, prices change".

days.hook: POV: you checked the flight price again and it went up
days.scenes: Laptop glow close-up → slow push on a tired face → price number ticks up.
days.cta: Send to the friend who's "waiting for it to drop"

days.hook: That tiny hole in the plane window has a job
days.scenes: Macro of the window hole → 3-pane cutaway animation → pressure balance explained in one line.
days.cta: Follow for one secret a week
claims: Window 'breather/bleed hole' equalises pressure between inner and middle panes so the outer pane carries the cabin pressure load — verify on an aviation/manufacturer source

days.hook: Stop booking return tickets by default
days.scenes: Myth: return is always cheaper → Truth: two one-ways on different airlines can beat it → How: search one-way both directions, compare total.

days.scenes: Seat-back POV → split screen A FINE / B RUDE → hold on question.

days.hook: Flight delayed 3+ hours? You might be owed up to £520
days.scenes: Delay board → UK261 bands: £220 short-haul, £350 medium, £260–£520 long-haul (top band needs 4 h+), not owed for "extraordinary circumstances" → "check if you qualify" (site's delay-compensation page, soft link #1).
days.cta: Send to whoever's flight got delayed
claims: UK261 bands £220 / £350 / £260–£520, 3h threshold, 4h+ for full long-haul, extraordinary circumstances — verify on caa.co.uk / gov.uk

days.hook: The 24-hour rule most Americans don't use
days.scenes: US DOT rule: free cancel within 24 h on qualifying bookings → how to use it to lock a fare and keep looking.
claims: US DOT 24-hour rule (14 CFR 259.5): qualifying conditions incl. booked ≥7 days before departure; hold-or-cancel option — verify on transportation.gov
